description: This file contains implementation code for interfacing with an LIS302DL accelerometer sensor using SPI on an STM32F4 Discovery board. It includes configuration functions, initialization routines, and a thread for reading sensor data periodically.

methods.name: configureAccelerometerPins
methods.description: Configures GPIO pins for the accelerometer interface on the STM32F4 Discovery board.

methods.name: initAccelerometer
methods.description: Initializes the accelerometer hardware, SPI communication, and starts a thread to read accelerometer data periodically.
